Tyk Retrieve Information of All the Connected Data Plane Nodes.

items.docs: Provides a list of all the data plane nodes connected to MDCB. Data plane nodes are Tyk Gateways that make your APIs available to your consumers. MDCB offers centralised management of your data plane nodes. This endpoint offers metadata and status for all connected data plane nodes, allowing for monitoring and troubleshooting.
